answer: An identity earns trust only while its signed record stays single-valued. Each identity locks 40 credits and signs one pulse per epoch. A delta between two records for one slot proves equivocation. Proof slashes 30 percent, leaving a marked ember frozen one epoch. A double-signing farm cannot reuse one stake: the 1000th puppet still costs 40 credits, so 1000 cost 40000 linearly; one slip burns 12. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep full rewards.
